props.name: colorMap
props.comment: Maps the value at `colorSource` to a CSS color.

props.name: defaultView
props.comment: The view shown first; the first of `views` when it is not among them.

props.name: eventRenderer
props.comment: Replaces the coloured block inside each event button.

props.name: linkType
props.comment: Where an event links when `onSelectEvent` is unset: the edit page, else the show page. `false` makes it inert.

props.name: onDrop
props.comment:
Makes month-view events draggable to another day. Called with the record
and its moved ISO `start`, and `end` when the event had one; not called for
a drop on the day it came from. The list is not updated here: save, and the
list refetches. A rejection is left to the caller. Native drag and drop
does not work on touch screens and has no keyboard form, so
`onSelectEvent` stays the route to an edit form.

props.name: onSelectSlot
props.comment: An empty part of a day cell was clicked, or Enter or Space pressed on it.

props.name: perPage
props.comment: Records fetched per range, so a month is not cut off at the list default.

props.name: rangeFilter
props.comment:
The list filter for the visible range, for a provider that names its
operators otherwise. Default: `<startSource>_gte` and `<startSource>_lte`,
or with `endSource` set `<startSource>_lte` and `<endSource>_gte`, which
also fetches an event that starts before the range. A record with an empty
end is then left out, so such data needs a custom `rangeFilter`.

props.name: startSource
props.comment: The field holding an event's start; also the field the default range filter is keyed on.

props.name: titleSource
props.comment: The field holding an event's title; the record representation when unset or empty.

props.name: views
props.comment: The views offered; the switcher is hidden while one remains.
